blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Office of the Ombudsman on Friday filed three counts of graft against former Pampanga Rep. Aurelio “Dong” Gonzales Jr. over his alleged links to construction firms that secured Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) contracts while he was in office. Ombudsman personnel went to the Sandiganbayan to file the informations containing the formal charges against Gonzales. READ: Governor, ex-lawmaker face Ombudsman preliminary investigation Assistant Ombudsman Mico Clavano earlier said Gonzales was facing a conflict-of-interest complaint over reports that a firm linked to his family had secured hundreds of millions of pesos in DPWH contracts during his […]...
